title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-22 00:00:21 最新章节：第140章 他要是个女的该多好
content_zh:
“呼……哈……”
“仙子请自重，我不是那种人！”
陈玄坐在地上不断往后退，直到后背整个贴在墙壁上，胳膊撑着地满脸惊疑，眼神又惊又惧。
面前半敞着轻纱道衣的女人神色妩媚，面颊上带着红晕，眼含秋波、神态迷离，膝盖弯曲半跪在地，不断朝他逼近。
女人喘着粗气，像沐浴炉火之中，燥热感令她有些窒息，褪去挂在肩头的轻纱，露出雪白的臂膀。
陈玄脑子嗡嗡的，眼前场景让他晕头转向，一股温热冲破天灵盖，鼻腔一热。
“帮帮我～”
女人伸出舌头舔舐嘴唇，神情娇媚，眉心却簇作一团，拧成个‘川’字，语气带着些许央求，眼中含着无尽欲望，像是看着即将到手的猎物。
陈玄闭上眼睛默念清心经，强压下心头升腾的火苗。
姑奶奶啊，你可放过我吧……
自打来了修仙界，我为人谨慎、与人为善，从不做伤天害理之事，言行文明、举止得当，好不容易进了仙门，总不能栽在这里。
色字头上一把刀啊！
女人的滚烫的手搭在陈玄脖子上，吓得他浑身一激灵，感受到喷在脸上的温热气息，他只觉头晕目眩。
不管了，先快活完再说！
不行不行，绝对不行，这是门中的仙子，变成这样定是遭人暗算，要是完事后清醒过来，指定一剑劈了他，总不能贪图一时快活丢了性命。
陈玄心中有两个声音在吵架。
可此时仙子整个身子已贴在他胸前，胸前一颗纽扣似是难以支撑，随时都有可能蹦飞，香肩如霜、肤若凝脂，淡淡的清香顺着鼻息而入。
一睁眼，是仙子近在咫尺的绝美面容，水波荡漾的眸子深情款款的看着他，将他魂都勾了去。
“淦！”
陈玄心中万马奔腾，“既然如此，对不住了仙子，陈某实是不得已而为之！”

他一把抓住仙子的肩膀，反将她推到在地，顺势向前骑坐仙子身上。
“嗯～”仙子呢喃声让人骨头酥软，她闭上双眼脸偏向一侧，像是做好被人拿捏的准备。
啪啪啪！
接连三声清脆的响声，陈玄轮圆了臂膀，又是一个响亮的大嘴巴抽在仙子脸上。
仙子白嫩的脸颊以肉眼可见的速度肿胀起来。
爽！
陈玄早就看这些道貌岸然的‘上仙’不顺眼了，今日终于得偿所愿，正要再抽她几巴掌过过瘾，低头却见仙子眼神清澈，正一脸愠怒地看着他。
仙子一脚蹬在陈玄肚子，将他整个人踹飞出去，重重砸在墙壁上。
她“噌”的一声拔出宝剑，抵住陈玄脖子，眼中像要喷出火来，怒喝道，“你个腌臜的东西，竟敢对本仙子生出歹意，看我不弄死你个畜生！”
“仙子冤枉啊……”
陈玄求饶的话还没说出口，仙子的剑已经刺了过来。
剑插在距离他跨下不足五寸处，惊出他一身冷汗，只觉嘴唇发干，滚动喉咙咽了口唾沫。
他惊恐抬头看向仙子，见仙子扶着额头摇摇欲坠。
“这帮该死的东西，居然给本仙子下药！”仙子双腿一软坐在地上，扭头看向陈玄，喘息粗重，眼神时而凌厉、时而恍惚。
陈玄战战兢兢道，“仙子多有得罪，方才小人打你也是为唤醒你。”
“该死……是销魂夺命散……”
仙子顾不上听陈玄的解释，匆忙盘坐地上，双手置于腹部掐诀，运功压制体内毒素。
content_en:
"Huh... ha..."
"Fairy, please respect yourself, I'm not that kind of person!"
Chen Xuan sat on the ground and kept retreating until his back was pressed against the wall, his arms propped up on the ground with a look of surprise on his face, and his eyes were frightened and frightened.
The woman with the gauze robe half open in front of her face looked charming, with a blush on her cheeks, her eyes were full of eyes, her expression was blurred, her knees were bent and she was half-kneeling on the ground, and she kept approaching him.
The woman was breathing heavily, as if she were bathing in a fire. The heat made her suffocated. She took off the gauze hanging on her shoulders, revealing her snow-white arms.
Chen Xuan's mind was buzzing, and the scene in front of him made him dizzy. A wave of warmth broke through the Tianling Gai, and his nasal cavity felt hot.
"Help me~"
The woman stuck out her tongue and licked her lips, with a coquettish look on her face, but her eyebrows were twisted into the character "Chuan". Her tone was pleading, and her eyes were full of endless desire, as if she was looking at the prey that was about to be obtained.
Chen Xuan closed his eyes and recited the Qingxin Sutra silently, suppressing the rising fire in his heart.
Auntie, please let me go...
Since I came to the world of cultivating immortals, I have been cautious and kind to others. I have never done anything harmful to nature. I have been civilized and behaved appropriately. After finally entering the immortal world, I can't fall here.
The word "sex" has a knife on its head!
The woman's hot hands were placed on Chen Xuan's neck, which frightened him all over. He felt the warm breath on his face and felt dizzy.
No matter, let’s finish having fun first!
No, no, absolutely not. This is the fairy in the sect. Someone must have plotted him to become like this. If he wakes up after the incident and kills him with a designated sword, he cannot lose his life just for the sake of temporary happiness.
There were two voices quarreling in Chen Xuan's heart.
But at this time, the fairy's entire body was pressed against his chest. A button on his chest seemed to be difficult to support and might fly away at any time. Her shoulders were like frost, her skin was like gelatin, and a faint fragrance flowed in along her nose.
When he opened his eyes, he saw the fairy's beautiful face very close at hand. Her rippling eyes looked at him affectionately, drawing his soul away.
"Gan!"
Chen Xuan's heart was racing, "In this case, I'm sorry to the fairy, Chen has no choice but to do this!"
He grabbed the fairy's shoulders, pushed her to the ground, and moved forward to ride on the fairy.
"Hmm~" The fairy murmured in a voice that made people feel soft. She closed her eyes and turned her face to one side, as if she was ready to be manipulated.
Bang bang bang!
With three crisp sounds in succession, Chen Xuanlun rounded his arms and slapped the fairy on the face with another loud mouth.
The fairy's fair and tender cheeks swelled up at a speed visible to the naked eye.
Cool!
Chen Xuan had long been dissatisfied with these sanctimonious 'immortals', and today he finally got what he wanted. He was about to slap her a few more times to enjoy himself, but when he lowered his head, he saw the fairy looking at him with clear eyes and an angry look on her face.
The fairy kicked Chen Xuan in the stomach, sending him flying out and hitting the wall hard.
She pulled out her sword with a "chun" sound and pressed it against Chen Xuan's neck. Her eyes seemed to burst out with fire and she yelled angrily, "You filthy thing, how dare you have any ill intentions towards me, this fairy? I won't kill you, you beast!"
"The fairy was wronged..."
Before Chen Xuan could even say his begging for mercy, the fairy's sword had already stabbed him.
The sword was inserted less than five inches away from his step, causing him to break into a cold sweat. His lips felt dry, and he swallowed as his throat rolled.
He looked up at the fairy in fear and saw the fairy holding her forehead and shaking.
"These damn things actually drugged this fairy!" The fairy's legs softened and she sat on the ground. She turned to look at Chen Xuan, breathing heavily, and her eyes were sometimes sharp and sometimes trance-like.
Chen Xuanzhan said tremblingly, "Fairy has offended many people, and the villain just hit you just to wake you up."
"Damn it...it's Ecstasy..."
The fairy didn't bother to listen to Chen Xuan's explanation, and hurriedly sat cross-legged on the ground, placed her hands on her abdomen and kneaded the secrets, using her kung fu to suppress the toxins in her body.
